faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.description: Get quick answers to common questions about our yoga classes, programs, trainers, and memberships.

items.question: Do I Need Prior Experience to Join?
items.answer: No, you don't need any prior experience. Our classes are designed for all levels, including complete beginners. Our trainers will guide you step by step at a comfortable pace.

items.question: What Should I Bring to Class?
items.answer: Wear comfortable clothes. Mats, blocks, and blankets are available in the studio if you do not bring your own.

items.question: Is Yoga Safe for My Health Condition?
items.answer: Tell your trainer about any injury or condition before class. Sessions can be adjusted so the practice stays safe for you.

items.question: Can Yoga Help with Stress or Anxiety?
items.answer: Yes. Slow breathing and gentle movement help the body settle and make daily stress easier to handle.

items.question: Do You Offer Packages or Memberships?
items.answer: Yes. Drop-in classes, class packs, and monthly memberships are available. Ask us which one fits your week.
